description: Super-admin UI on /super-admin/payments: the 9 tabs from plan §9 with URL tab state, new Razorpay panels and subscription detail drawer (Sync, Cancel with reason + password + confirm), Subscribers AutoPay column and the F6 warning on manual grant/extend/end actions. Implements plan.md steps 5 and 6. Depends on FEAT-001 (routes, admin-status.ts). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read plan.md design decisions 10-12 and steps 5-6, FEAT-001 findings (exact route response shapes), and src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx for the Suspense + useSearchParams + replaceSearchParams pattern.

Step 5: extend src/app/api/super-admin/billing/subscriptions/route.ts GET with the per-subscriber autopay block (one extra billing_subscriptions query, prefer live over test then newest, charging = authenticated/active/pending and not cancel_at_cycle_end); add SubscriberAutopay to src/types/super-admin.ts; create src/components/super-admin/billing/autopay-warning.tsx (AutopayManualActionWarning, give/date vs end copy from plan.md); add the AutoPay column and the warning inside ManageSubscriptionDialog in src/components/super-admin/billing/subscribers-panel.tsx.
Step 5 test: src/components/super-admin/billing/autopay-warning.test.tsx with renderToStaticMarkup (cases in plan.md step 5).

Step 6: rewrite the tab shell in src/app/(super-admin)/super-admin/payments/page.tsx (Suspense, tab/sub URL state via replaceSearchParams, 9 tabs in plan order, default overview, Manual payments keeps PaymentRequestsPanel + drawer unchanged with the pending count fetched on mount, scrollable tab bar).

Step 6: create src/components/super-admin/billing/razorpay-shared.tsx, razorpay-overview-panel.tsx, razorpay-subscriptions-panel.tsx, razorpay-subscription-drawer.tsx, razorpay-transactions-panel.tsx, razorpay-invoices-panel.tsx, razorpay-refunds-disputes-panel.tsx, razorpay-webhooks-panel.tsx exactly as described in plan.md step 6 (light slate palette, amber Test pill on every test-mode row, server error text shown, real buttons and labels, read-only vs changes-billing action groups, actions disabled with the reason when canAct is false).
Step 6: add billing_admin_action (and any missing autopay event) labels to src/components/super-admin/billing/activity-panel.tsx.
Run this FEAT's verification commands; eslint and prettier on touched files only.
acceptance_criteria: /super-admin/payments renders 9 tabs in plan §9 order, ?tab= selects a tab and switching tabs updates the URL without a server navigation
Existing Subscribers, Activity and Manual payments (payment requests queue with approve/reject for pending rows) still work
Subscribers table shows an AutoPay column and the F6 warning appears in the manage dialog for an account with charging AutoPay, proven by autopay-warning.test.tsx
Every Razorpay panel marks test-mode rows with a visible Test label
npx tsc --noEmit clean for src/, npx eslint clean on the touched files, npx vitest run full suite green
findings:
STATUS: plan.md steps 5 and 6 implemented. None of the FEAT-003 files existed before this run. No DB changes, no Razorpay calls, no commits.

STEP 5: GET /api/super-admin/billing/subscriptions runs one extra billing_subscriptions query (status in authenticated/active/pending/halted/paused, plan columns + created_at for ordering) in the same Promise.all and attaches autopay per subscriber: live preferred over test, then newest; charging = CHARGING_STATUSES and cancel_at_cycle_end !== true. If that query fails the list still loads and autopay is undefined (UI shows "Unknown"), never null ("None"). PATCH unchanged. SubscriberAutopay + autopay?: on SubscriberRow in src/types/super-admin.ts. autopay-warning.tsx (AutopayManualActionWarning, role=note, amber box, plan copy for give/date and end, null unless charging, null for the advanced intent, link ?tab=subscriptions&sub=<id> that switches tab client-side when onOpenAutopay is given). subscribers-panel.tsx: AutoPay column between Term and Ends (status pill, Test pill, method, next charge or "Not charging"; "None"/"Unknown"), colSpan 6 -> 7, warning at the top of the ManageSubscriptionDialog body; SubscribersPanel takes optional onOpenAutopay.
TEST: autopay-warning.test.tsx (renderToStaticMarkup), 13 tests: authenticated/active/pending render amount ₹999 and IST date 6 Apr 2027 (20:00Z on 5 Apr); test mode named "(authorised, test mode)"; date intent warns; halted, paused, cancel-at-cycle-end (charging false), null and undefined render nothing for give and end; end copy differs from give; link href; advanced renders nothing.

STEP 6: payments/page.tsx rewritten shell: Suspense wrapper + inner reading tab/sub via useSearchParams, writes via replaceSearchParams (no server navigation), 9 tabs in plan order (Overview, AutoPay subscriptions, Transactions, Invoices, Refunds & disputes, Webhooks & reconciliation, Subscribers, Activity, Manual payments (n)), unknown/missing tab -> overview, sub must be a UUID, role=tablist/tab/aria-selected, overflow-x-auto bar. Pending count fetched once on mount from payment-requests?status=pending&pageSize=10 (counts.pending). PaymentRequestsPanel, StatusTile and PaymentRequestDrawer usage are byte-for-byte unchanged under the manual tab. Drawer renders when tab=subscriptions and sub is set; closing removes sub; Sync/Cancel bump a reload key so the list refetches.
New components: razorpay-shared.tsx (ModeBadge amber Test / slate Live, StatusPill with words, formatMinor via fromMinor + en-IN currency with paise only when non-zero, formatIst via formatBillingDate (+ time variant), humanize, methodText ("Not known yet" instead of guessing), CopyId, RazorpayLink via dashboardUrl, errorMessage (server error text; 429 -> "Too many attempts. Try again in N seconds."; 5xx appends HTTP status), postJson, useAdminJson, useAdminList, useDebounced, usePagedFilters, SearchBox/FilterSelect with aria-labels, Th, TableStateRow, ListPagination, ListFrame); razorpay-overview-panel.tsx (configured/mode banner, manual pending tile, per-mode blocks live first: trialing with AutoPay, active, authorised, pending, halted, cancelled, completed, charges due 7 d, failed payments 7 d, webhook last received/failed/dead/anomalies, last run with negative durations suppressed); razorpay-subscriptions-panel.tsx (search, mode/status incl. live group/method/sort filters, pagination, row click + Details button set sub); razorpay-subscription-drawer.tsx (Sheet; summary incl. paidThrough, invoices, payments with error text, events timeline with actor + source, webhook events; Read-only group Sync now/Copy id/Open in Razorpay; Changes billing group Cancel AutoPay; both disabled with the reason when canAct is false, no provider id, or status not ADMIN_CANCELLABLE; cancel form: reason 5-500, password, 2FA code field revealed after two_factor_code_required/invalid_two_factor_code, checkbox "I understand this stops AutoPay at Razorpay immediately and cannot be undone.", submit disabled until all set, server error shown); razorpay-transactions-panel.tsx; razorpay-invoices-panel.tsx; razorpay-refunds-disputes-panel.tsx (shared mode + search, two paged tables, unresolved dispute within 3 days highlighted with "Due in N days"/"Due today"/"Deadline passed"); razorpay-webhooks-panel.tsx (events default "Failed or dead", anomaly checkbox, Retry on failed/dead with confirm, disabled with reason when the row mode differs from the server mode read from /overview; reconciliation runs with triggered-by name/Cron, "Run reconciliation now" with confirm, 429 text shown). Every list marks test rows with the amber Test pill and a faint amber row tint.
activity-panel.tsx: labels for billing_admin_action ("Admin billing action") and all 16 autopay/payment/refund/dispute/anomaly event types; billing_admin_action added to the type filter (the events route passes type straight to .eq, so it works). Unknown types still fall back to the raw value.

DEVIATIONS: (1) Additive server change in admin-db.ts (FEAT-001 file): WEBHOOK_EVENT_LIST_SPEC statuses gain "retryable" and listAdminWebhookEvents maps it to status IN (failed, dead), mirroring the existing "live" group, because plan step 6 asks for a failed+dead default and the API only took one status. (2) The subscriptions list column is "Cycle ends" (Razorpay current_end): the list row has no paid-through value (only the detail does), and showing current_end as "paid through" would be a substituted value. Paid-through is in the drawer. (3) Transactions show no settlement id: billing_payments/AdminPaymentRow has no such column. (4) Admin cancel copy states the access already granted is unchanged (design decision 2). (5) Dashboard deep-link format remains unverified (admin-status.ts note).

VERIFICATION: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" -> no output. npx vitest run -> 204 files, 2576 tests passed. npx eslint "src/app/(super-admin)/super-admin/payments" src/components/super-admin/billing src/app/api/super-admin/billing/subscriptions src/types/super-admin.ts src/lib/billing/razorpay/admin-db.ts -> exit 0, no output. npx prettier --write on the 15 touched files; HEAD blobs of the 5 tracked files were already Prettier-clean (checked with the prettier API), git diff --stat identical before and after (only CRLF working-copy line endings normalised). .next-verify build not run (not in FEAT-003 verification; plan step 7). Temporary scratch scripts deleted; scratch/phase5-md5.js and phase5-routes.js predate this step and were left.
